purpose: The declared verification tier of every maintained source unit in this root, as STD-0007 requires. A unit is Tier H when its input can be chosen by something outside the lane's trust boundary, or when it validates a path or a locator, which the standard names by name. A unit is Tier A when it owns an accepted invariant whose violation is silent. Everything else is Tier O. Where a unit could belong to two tiers the higher applies.

units.reason: Projects the configuration's assertion level onto the three macros. A wrong mapping removes a check in one configuration and leaves it in another, which is the failure nobody sees.
Parses hexadecimal identity text whose bytes come from a manifest, a wire, or an artifact, and must reject every noncanonical spelling rather than conclude from one.
Two span aliases. They own no trust decision and no silent invariant.
Declares the install-once handler slot and the freeze. A second installation that succeeded would redirect termination without saying so.
Owns the pinned compiler and architecture gate. Admitting an unsupported toolchain here is silent everywhere else.
Owns the termination path itself: the write-once slot, the re-entry flag, and the guarantee that the process ends even when the handler returns or the sink fails.
